race.comment: CHEVAL DE BOIS (1) made it three minor placings on the trot when powered home late to be beaten under a length over 2000m at Rosehill last start. Brings strong Saturday form to a moderate midweek fixture but does go up 7kgs to compensate. Very fit and doubt the big weight will stop him. SISTER DAAE (3) continues to hit the line well and pick up minor prizemoney at midweek fixtures, most recently seven days ago when she got home for third over 1550m here. New to this trip but it looks the right move. EQUINOX LEGEND (6) scored a big win two back of the mile at Kembla but disappointed at Newcastle last time - worth another chance. KUMBAYA (11) made steady ground to get up for third over 1550m here a week ago. Gets out to 1900m at the fourth run back which looks a nice scenario. The remaining runners look to have little hope.
